final_verdict: MAIW V2 INDEPENDENT POST-RELEASE AUDIT FAIL
verdict_reason: No P0. Core v2 security architecture (authority boundary, RuntimeCapabilityPolicy, SOP Engine validator/evidence/state-predicate/version-pinning/UNKNOWN-reconciliation, fresh live-sandbox isolation, ModelGateway canonicality + no-mock-fallback, model-family policy) independently REPRODUCED and holds. But 5 P1 findings — an ungoverned model-driven write path in the shipped app, the inference endpoint absent from the deployed app, durable persistence not wired, false-ready readiness, and a legacy Llama/mock document path — are material correctness/safety-claim failures per spec section 72 (any unresolved P1 => FAIL).
